spans.s:
m. (-पः)
1 Rejection, cutting off in general, especially used as a grammatical term for dropping letters, syllables, &c.
2 Disappearance, destruction.
3

Annulling, cancelling.
E.
लुप to cut, aff. घञ्.

f. (-पा)
The wife of the Muni AGASTYA.
E.
लुप to disturb, aff. अच् and टाष्.

m. (-कः)
A Shakāl.
E.
लुप to cut, आकन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A Shakāl.
f. (-पिका)
A fox.
E.
लोप rejection (offal), आप to take, aff. वुन्.

f. (-द्रा)
The wife of the saint AGASTYA.
E.
लोप losing (reputation), अमुद्रा sad, not happy.

m. (-तिः)
The Muni AGASTYA.
E.
लोपामुद्रा as above, and पति husband.

m. (-कः)
A Shakāl.
f. (-शिका)
1 A female

A fox.
E.
लोप rejection, अश to eat, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be rejected, erased, lost, &c.
E.
लुप to cut off, ण्यत् aff.

nf. (-प्त्रं-प्त्री)
Plunder, booty.
E.
लुप to cut off, ष्ट्रन् aff.
